revenue_scope: Mulpleta line in Shionogi's 'Sales of Prescription Drugs in Japan' table

series_start_reason: Mulpleta was approved in Japan in September 2015 (launch_evidence). The first quarter for which a figure can be read is FY2016 Q1 (April-June 2016 = 2016Q2), from the prior-year column of the FY2017 Q1 presentation (e_p170731.pdf). The FY2015 results documents (sup16_05.pdf, e_p160511.pdf) and the FY2016 Q1-Q3 presentations (e_p160801.pdf, e_p161031_1/_2.pdf, e_p161101.pdf, e_p170202.pdf) name Mulpleta only in text or pipeline pages, with no sales figure; the FY2016 results presentation (e_p170510.pdf) prints the year only to one decimal (0.1). No Shionogi document located dates the Japanese launch quarter, so launch_quarter is null.
series_end_reason: From FY2020 Shionogi prints the Japan Mulpleta line to one decimal of a billion yen only: the FY2020 cumulative figures are 0.0 (three months, e-P-200731.pdf), 0.1 (six months, e_201102.pdf), 0.1 (nine months, e_210201.pdf) and 0.1 (twelve months, e_210510.pdf), and the supplements' quarterly-trend tables print every quarter from FY2020 as 0.0 (e.g. E_FY2022.4Q_Supplement.pdf 'MULPLETA 0.0 (12.4) 0.0 (3.0) 0.0 (23.2) 0.0 (29.1)'). A quarter can no longer be resolved, so the series ends at FY2019 Q4 (January-March 2020 = 2020Q1). Full-year figures continue at 0.1 B yen through FY2023 (see notes); the FY2023 supplement states that from FY2024 Mulpleta is included in 'Others'.
notes: FY2016-FY2019 presentations print the Japan line as fiscal year-to-date cumulative figures in billions of yen to two decimals. Fiscal Q1 rows are read directly; later quarters are cumulative less the previous cumulative figure (year_to_date_less_reported_quarters). FY2016 cumulative figures (0.03, 0.06, 0.09, 0.13) are the prior-year columns of the FY2017 documents. Each cumulative figure carries up to 0.005 B yen of rounding, so a derived quarter of 0.02-0.05 B yen can be off by 0.01 B yen (up to half its value). The FY2018 Q1 presentation is published at a URL named e_p170730.pdf although its title is 'Overview of 1Q FY2018 Financial Results'. Prior-year columns agree with the figures printed the year before, except FY2017 full year: 0.16 in the FY2017 presentation and in the FY2018 presentation's prior-year column, 0.2 in the FY2017 supplement (one decimal). Annual Japan figures after the series end (one decimal, B yen): FY2020 0.1, FY2021 0.1, FY2022 0.1, FY2023 0.1. A separate U.S. Mulpleta line under Shionogi Inc. exists for FY2018-FY2019 only (FY2018 0.08; FY2019 cumulative 0.15, 0.34, 0.43, 0.54 in e_p190729.pdf, e_p191030.pdf, e_p200203.pdf, e_p200511.pdf); it is shorter and a different scope, so it is not used. Mulpleta is sold in China by a licensee (Eddingpharm); no figure found. Replaces the annual series shionogi_mulpleta_annual.csv.
